have alg1 : ∀ (a b x : K), b ≠ 0 → (1 * x + a / b) * b = b * x + a := by
    intro a b x hb
    calc (1 * x + a / b) * b = x * b + a * (b * b⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = b * x + a := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hb, mul_one]; ring
  have alg2 : ∀ (a b E0 E1 E2 A0 A1 A2 B0 B1 B2 : K), B2 ≠ 0 →
      E2 = (1 - a * B0 / B2) * E1 + a * B0 / B2 * E0 →
      A2 = b * A1 + a * A0 → B2 = b * B1 + a * B0 →
      E0 * B0 = A0 → E1 * B1 = A1 → E2 * B2 = A2 := by
    intro a b E0 E1 E2 A0 A1 A2 B0 B1 B2 hB2 hE hA hBr h0 h1
    subst hE hA h0 h1
    calc ((1 - a * B0 / B2) * E1 + a * B0 / B2 * E0) * B2
        = E1 * B2 + (a * B0 * E0 - a * B0 * E1) * (B2 * B2⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = E1 * B2 + (a * B0 * E0 - a * B0 * E1) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hB2, mul_one]
      _ = E1 * (b * B1 + a * B0) + (a * B0 * E0 - a * B0 * E1) := by rw [← hBr]
      _ = b * (E1 * B1) + a * (E0 * B0) := by ring
  have key : ∀ m, m ≤ n → g.toEuler.nums m * g.dens m = g.nums m := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      match m with
      | 0 =>
        intro _
        show g.toEuler.nums 0 * g.dens 0 = g.nums 0
        simp only [zeroth_num_eq_h, zeroth_den_eq_one, mul_one, toEuler_h]
      | 1 =>
        intro hm1
        show g.toEuler.nums 1 * g.dens 1 = g.nums 1
        rcases hs : g.s.get? 0 with _ | ⟨a, b⟩
        · have hT : g.TerminatedAt 0 := hs
          have hT' : g.toEuler.TerminatedAt 0 := terminatedAt_toEuler.mpr hT
          rw [nums_stable_of_terminated (Nat.zero_le 1) hT',
            dens_stable_of_terminated (Nat.zero_le 1) hT,
            nums_stable_of_terminated (Nat.zero_le 1) hT]
          simp only [zeroth_num_eq_h, zeroth_den_eq_one, mul_one, toEuler_h]
        · have hs' : g.toEuler.s.get? 0 = some ⟨a / b, 1⟩ := by
            rw [toEuler_s_zero, hs]
            try rfl
          have hB1 : g.dens 1 = b := first_den_eq hs
          have hA1 : g.nums 1 = b * g.h + a := first_num_eq hs
          have hE1 : g.toEuler.nums 1 = 1 * g.h + a / b := first_num_eq hs'
          have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
            rw [← hB1]
            exact hB 1 hm1
          rw [hE1, hB1, hA1]
          exact alg1 a b g.h hb
      | k + 2 =>
        intro hm2
        show g.toEuler.nums (k + 2) * g.dens (k + 2) = g.nums (k + 2)
        have ih0 := ih k (by omega) (by omega)
        have ih1 := ih (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        rcases hs : g.s.get? (k + 1) with _ | ⟨a, b⟩
        · have hT : g.TerminatedAt (k + 1) := hs
          have hT' : g.toEuler.TerminatedAt (k + 1) := terminatedAt_toEuler.mpr hT
          rw [nums_stable_of_terminated (show k + 1 ≤ k + 2 by omega) hT',
            dens_stable_of_terminated (show k + 1 ≤ k + 2 by omega) hT,
            nums_stable_of_terminated (show k + 1 ≤ k + 2 by omega) hT]
          exact ih1
        · have hs' : g.toEuler.s.get? (k + 1) =
              some ⟨a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2), 1 - a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2)⟩ := by
            rw [toEuler_s_succ, hs]
            try rfl
          have hA : g.nums (k + 2) = b * g.nums (k + 1) + a * g.nums k :=
            nums_recurrence hs rfl rfl
          have hBr : g.dens (k + 2) = b * g.dens (k + 1) + a * g.dens k :=
            dens_recurrence hs rfl rfl
          have hE : g.toEuler.nums (k + 2) =
              (1 - a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2)) * g.toEuler.nums (k + 1) +
                a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2) * g.toEuler.nums k :=
            nums_recurrence hs' rfl rfl
          exact alg2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hB (k + 2) hm2) hE hA hBr ih0 ih1
  intro m hm

have key : ∀ k ≤ n, g.toEuler.nums k = g.nums k / g.dens k := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro hk
      match k with
      | 0 => simp [zeroth_num_eq_h, zeroth_den_eq_one]
      | 1 =>
        rcases hs : g.s.get? 0 with _ | ⟨a, b⟩
        · have ht : g.TerminatedAt 0 := hs
          have htE : g.toEuler.TerminatedAt 0 := terminatedAt_toEuler.mpr ht
          have e1 : g.toEuler.nums 1 = g.toEuler.nums 0 :=
            nums_stable_of_terminated (by omega) htE
          have e2 : g.nums 1 = g.nums 0 := nums_stable_of_terminated (by omega) ht
          have e3 : g.dens 1 = g.dens 0 := dens_stable_of_terminated (by omega) ht
          rw [e1, e2, e3]
          simp [zeroth_num_eq_h, zeroth_den_eq_one]
        · have hE : g.toEuler.s.get? 0 = some ⟨a / b, 1⟩ := by
            simp [toEuler_s_zero, hs]
          have e1 : g.toEuler.nums 1 = 1 * g.h + a / b := first_num_eq hE
          have e2 : g.nums 1 = b * g.h + a := first_num_eq hs
          have e3 : g.dens 1 = b := first_den_eq hs
          have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
            rw [← e3]
            exact hB 1 hk
          rw [e1, e2, e3]
          field_simp <;> ring
      | k + 2 =>
        have ih1 := ih (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        have ih0 := ih k (by omega) (by omega)
        rcases hs : g.s.get? (k + 1) with _ | ⟨a, b⟩
        · have ht : g.TerminatedAt (k + 1) := hs
          have htE : g.toEuler.TerminatedAt (k + 1) := terminatedAt_toEuler.mpr ht
          have e1 : g.toEuler.nums (k + 2) = g.toEuler.nums (k + 1) :=
            nums_stable_of_terminated (by omega) htE
          have e2 : g.nums (k + 2) = g.nums (k + 1) := nums_stable_of_terminated (by omega) ht
          have e3 : g.dens (k + 2) = g.dens (k + 1) := dens_stable_of_terminated (by omega) ht
          rw [e1, e2, e3]
          exact ih1
        · have hE : g.toEuler.s.get? (k + 1) =
              some ⟨a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2), 1 - a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2)⟩ := by
            simp [toEuler_s_succ, hs]
          have hEA : g.toEuler.nums (k + 2) =
              (1 - a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2)) * g.toEuler.nums (k + 1) +
                a * g.dens k / g.dens (k + 2) * g.toEuler.nums k :=
            nums_recurrence hE rfl rfl
          have hA2 : g.nums (k + 2) = b * g.nums (k + 1) + a * g.nums k :=
            nums_recurrence hs rfl rfl
          have hB2 : g.dens (k + 2) = b * g.dens (k + 1) + a * g.dens k :=
            dens_recurrence hs rfl rfl
          have hBk : g.dens k ≠ 0 := hB k (by omega)
          have hBk1 : g.dens (k + 1) ≠ 0 := hB (k + 1) (by omega)
          have hBk2 : b * g.dens (k + 1) + a * g.dens k ≠ 0 := by
            rw [← hB2]
            exact hB (k + 2) hk
          rw [hEA, ih1, ih0, hA2, hB2]
          field_simp <;> ring

have hsub : (rootSystem H).coroot '' b.support ⊆
      (Submodule.span K (range fun i : b.support ↦ (rootSystem H).coroot i) : Set H) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

      (Submodule.span K (range fun i : b.support ↦ (rootSystem H).coroot i)).toAddSubmonoid :=
    AddSubmonoid.closure_le.mpr hsub
  have hmem : ∀ α, (rootSystem H).coroot α ∈
      Submodule.span K (range fun i : b.support ↦ (rootSystem H).coroot i) := by
    intro α
    first
      | exact (b.coroot_mem_or_neg_mem α).elim (fun h => hcl h)
          (fun h => _root_.neg_mem_iff.mp (hcl h))
      | exact Submodule.span_le.mpr hsub
          (Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars ℤ K _ (b.coroot_mem_span_int α))
  have htop : Submodule.span K (range fun i : b.support ↦ (rootSystem H).coroot i) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← (rootSystem H).span_coroot_eq_top, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨α, rfl⟩
    exact hmem α
  have claim : ∀ y : H,
      y ∈ Submodule.span K (range fun i : b.support ↦ (rootSystem H).coroot i) →
      (y : L) ∈
        (lieSpan K L (range fun i : b.support ↦ ((rootSystem H).coroot i : L))).toSubmodule := by
    intro y hy

    | mem z hz =>

      exact LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan ⟨i, rfl⟩
    | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add z w _ _ hz hw => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz hw
    | smul c z _ hz => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hz
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    exact claim ⟨x, hx⟩ (by rw [htop]; exact Submodule.mem_top)
  · rw [LieSubalgebra.lieSpan_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩

    | zero =>
